articles.title: Fire at Goa’s Dabolim Airport quickly contained; flights unaffected
articles.summary: A minor fire erupted in an electrical switch room at Goa International Airport, Dabolim, on Saturday. Officials confirmed the blaze was quickly brought under control, preventing any casualties. This incident highlights the importance of robust safety protocols and rapid response mechanisms in critical infrastructure like airports, crucial for national security and public safety.

articles.title: Charlie Sheen’s 1998 Prevost Tour Bus Is For Sale

Sheen later sold the luxury vehicle to musician Tim Montana. The bus, with its unique celebrity provenance, has a notable history, suggesting a story about its subsequent ownership or modifications.

articles.title: One hundred seventy five Russian servicemen are returned from territory controlled by Kiev regime
articles.summary: Russia and Ukraine conducted a significant prisoner exchange, returning 175 servicemen each. 175 Russian personnel were released from Ukrainian-controlled territory, while Ukraine received 175 of its Armed Forces (AFU) Prisoners of War. This reciprocal exchange underscores ongoing humanitarian efforts despite the persistent conflict between the two nations.
